content:
[Intro]
[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]Thousand heads
cut clean across their necks right
down the hall from me
The reich's re-
lentless blade,
thirsty and shining red still
echoes of their screams

[Bridge]
[D5]This is a
tarnished heirloom,
passed down through
iron fists A shameful
house of doom, a
legacy of collapse
Built on a
painful truth

[Chorus]
[D5]A thousand
[E5]years of failure,
[Bb5]a thousand
[G5]years they [A5]bled.
[D5]To the
[E5]bear, the blitzkrieg, and the
[Bb5]holy father.
[G5]They [A5]just bowed their heads

[Bridge]
[D5]

[Verse 2]
[D5]
They meekly
did their time
Counting the days while harnessed
to their rusty
shackles Forever
occupied,
folded the crimson star, The
rabbits turned to
jackals,

[Bridge]
There's still
echoes of their screams

[Verse 3]
[D5]This is a
tarnished heirloom,
passed down through
iron fists A shameful
house of doom, a
legacy of collapse
Built on a
painful truth

[Chorus]
[D5]A thousand
[E5]years of failure,
[Bb5]a thousand
[G5]years they [A5]bled.
[D5]To the
[E5]bear, the blitzkrieg, and the
[Bb5]holy father.
[G5]They [A5]just bowed their heads

[Bridge]
[D5]
[D5]

[Verse 4]
Soviet hangover
eastern bloc.
And dirty money still
flows through locks.
A killing ground of rebels,
black marketeers
Restrained, but there's no re-
sistence here.
Southeast Asia in a
Euro cellblock.
Saigon's children conceal
what they've got
The opium trail runs
west through here
They're selling disease to
erase all your fears

[Interlude]
still
echoes of their screams,
still
echoes of their screams

[Chorus]
[D5]A thousand
[E5]years of failure,
[Bb5]a thousand
[G5]years they [A5]bled.
[D5]To the
[E5]bear, the blitzkrieg, and the
[Bb5]holy father.
[G5]They [A5]just bowed their heads

[Solo]
[D5]
[E5]
[Bb5]
[G5]I won't [A5]bow my head
[D5]
[E5]
[Bb5]
[G5]  [A5]

[Outro]
[D5]
title: Still Echoes
